sourceTitle: Keto Chicken Hash Recipe with Coconut Dijon Sauce
sourceText:
Keto Chicken Hash Recipe with Coconut Dijon Sauce
By: Keto Summit
Published: Friday, July 13, 2018 - 4:56am

Ingredients




4 chicken breasts (800 g), sliced into small slices
1 medium onion (110 g), sliced
2 carrots (100 g), grated
1 leek (90 g), sliced
4 Tablespoons of coconut oil (60 ml), to cook with
Salt and pepper, to taste
Coconut Dijon sauce

Preparation

1 Add the diced chicken breast to the coconut oil and saute until cooked.  Season with salt and pepper, to taste. 2 Add more coconut oil to the saute pan if necessary and cook the vegetables until tender.  Add the chicken pieces back in. 3 Serve with the coconut Dijon sauce.

About

DESCRIPTION: What makes this Keto dish outstanding is this coconut Dijon sauce! It’s full of healthy fats, and absolutely delicious.
